Fatalities in Vehicle

Description

This derived data element records the number of fatalities that occurred in this vehicle and is derived by counting all people with “Injury Severity” of 4 in the vehicle.
Valid range
min 0, max 99, note 0-99: Number of Fatalities That Occurred in the Vehicle.
